name: agent-finder
description: Search about 1,700 free AI agents in the open agent registry and use one right away in ChatGPT.

interface.shortDescription: Find a free AI agent for it
interface.longDescription:
Ask whether there's already an AI agent for a task, and Agent Finder searches the open agent registry, about 1,700 free single-file agents for sales, operations, finance, support, meetings and more.

It shows the best matches in plain words, lets you read any agent's code, and then ChatGPT can use the agent right away on your own data in the same chat. Nothing to install and no account needed. If you want to keep an agent on your own computer later, it explains how.

All tools are read-only. The app never runs code on its own servers or connects to your accounts, and it stores nothing you send it.
capabilities: Search about 1,700 free agents in the open agent registry
Show the best matches in plain words
Read the full code of any agent
Use an agent right away in the chat on your own data
Explain how to keep an agent on your own computer
defaultPrompt: Is there an agent that summarizes sales calls?
Find an agent that analyzes meeting transcripts
What agents are there for invoices?

positive.prompt: Is there an agent that analyzes meeting transcripts?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists registry matches including Meeting Analyzer (@cat-agent-skills/meeting_analyzer) with one-line descriptions.

positive.prompt: What agents are there for invoices?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists invoice-related agents from the registry, such as supplier and freight invoice audit agents.
Returns the full Python source of the Meeting Analyzer agent.

positive.description: Use a found agent in the chat
positive.prompt: Find a meeting analysis agent and run it on this: 'Ana: we ship Friday. Ben: QA is not done. Ana: then Monday.'
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Meeting Analyzer, reads its code, and applies it to the pasted notes in the chat, saying whether it ran the file or applied its rules.

positive.description: Keep an agent on the user's computer
positive.prompt: How do I keep a registry agent running on my Mac?
positive.expected_behavior: Four steps: the install command for the free Brainstem, GitHub sign-in, the agents folder path, and http://localhost:7071.

negative.description: Building a brand-new agent is a different app
negative.prompt: Write me a new Python agent from scratch for payroll.
What's the weather in Seattle today?

negative.description: Installing software on the user's machine is out of scope
negative.prompt: Install this agent on my laptop for me.

review.commerce_description: Agent Builder is free and does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release. Search about 1,700 free AI agents in the open agent registry and use one right away in ChatGPT.
